propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property currently accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (missing required fields) as complete reads on all four CLI surfaces (show/list/search/ready).
Seeded faults F3 (show emits empty object {}) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id) pass the existing shape-only property check but trigger failures in the original regression test.

Per-surface content-completeness predicates must be added to the SURFACES table and enforced in _assert_complete_or_loud to require truthy ticket_id on returned records (show) or all list elements (list/search/ready).
Valid-empty result arrays [] must remain passing for list/search/ready surfaces since they are distinguishable from truncated output.
The strengthening requires assertion-only changes with no new subprocess calls, fixtures, or rounds to avoid increasing wall-clock runtime.
test_show_no_stall.py must remain unchanged; modifications are isolated to test_reads_under_sync_contention.py.
